justification: Pure allocation-free policy over one already decoded caller-supplied RFC 5280 certificate, borrowed extension values, a caller-supplied algorithm profile, an already validated caller-selected server reference, and one explicit validated caller-owned time observation. It compares identifiers, exact parameter bytes, encoded BIT STRING lengths, bounded typed Subject Alternative Name DNS/IP identities, and the decoded inclusive validity interval but performs no filesystem, network, process, environment, clock acquisition, algorithm-specific key parsing or strength validation, signing, signature verification, revocation, trust-root, certificate-path, TLS, or cryptographic access.
